Respect is earned, never demanded… and Messi earned the respect of the entire world through years of dedication, sacrifice, and fighting for the Argentina shirt. His journey was never easy. He experienced painful defeats, criticism, and moments when many believed the dream was over, but he never gave up and never turned his back on Argentina. He continued to wear the shirt with pride, and every time he stepped onto the pitch, he proved that a true leader shows himself in the toughest moments. He fought for his country, created chances, scored goals, and stood at the center of the spotlight when the pressure was at its highest. Over the years, the pain turned into glory, the tears turned into celebrations, and Messi’s name became forever connected with Argentina’s history in the most beautiful way. He gave everything to that shirt and wrote unforgettable chapters in the history of football. Messi with Argentina was never just a player wearing the number 10… he was a leader, a symbol, and a figure millions connected with. The respect he earned did not come from trophies alone, but from every moment he fought for his country and every time he stood tall, despite everything, to continue writing history.🐐 #messi
